subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------MT.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in PMBA-21 (Popular Music in Black America). The following prose names the structural target: 'There were many other factors related to the spread and dissemination of rock music in the middle to late fifties, and all of these considerations would help define the transfer-shift implications of American popular music.' The crossing diagrams how composite-continuance structurally meets meta-information at the rock-music-spread scale: C-CONT (composite continuance) crossed with MT-INFO (meta-information). C-CONT sits at top-center with the subject-arrow; POL-DY (political dynamics) at upper-left and TR-INFO (transformation-information) at upper-right with P-FC (political focus/functionalism) and SG (source-generation) anchoring the upper-right margin. CULT-SOLD (culture-soldered) sits centrally as the bridging hub; TRS (transformation) at right and VT-PLT (vibrational plateau) and WO-EXP-PRI (world-exposure principle) below as the partner-side downward chain. SOC-RT (social reality) at center-left with UTZ (utilization) and RE-DOC (redocumentation) below as the subject-side downward chain. MT-INFO at the bottom-center as partner-axis with AF-DY (affinity dynamics) below as terminus. Structural argument: when composite-continuance is crossed with meta-information, the upper diagonal POL-DY → C-CONT → TR-INFO → P-FC → SG is the *political-source-generation route* — political-dynamics routes through composite-continuance into transformation-information, then through political-focus into source-generation. CULT-SOLD → TRS → VT-PLT → WO-EXP-PRI is the bridging-to-partner chain — culture-soldered routes through transformation into vibrational-plateau and finally into world-exposure-principle. SOC-RT → UTZ → RE-DOC is the subject's downward chain — social-reality routes through utilization into redocumentation. AF-DY at the partner-axis bottom is the affinity-dynamics terminus. The structural argument: the transfer-shift implications the prose names are structurally produced when the upper diagonal SG arrives at the partner-side as the conversion-output — composite-continuance's actual working gets re-sourced through political-focus into source-generation under the partner-axis's control, while the form's own working chain SOC-RT → UTZ → RE-DOC produces redocumentation as the subject-side terminus. The form's composite-continuance is transferred via the upper-chain's source-generation rather than through the bridging CULT-SOLD's vibrational route — that is the transfer-shift's structural shape.
